info.title: Fabric IQ Ontology Data Agent (Auto FNOL Triage)
info.description: Public-endpoint (app-autofnol-workiq.azurewebsites.net) wrapper exposing the Fabric ontology data agent's MCP endpoint to the Foundry orchestrator agent, secured by a shared API key header. Backed by triggers/webapp/tools_fabric_iq.py, which authenticates to the underlying Fabric MCP endpoint using the dedicated Agent Identity's delegated token (see shared/agent_identity_auth.py and docs/OBO_Bot_Teams_Design.docx) - required because the Fabric ontology data agent's Lakehouse binding only accepts delegated/real-user auth, not app-only tokens.

post.summary: Query the AutoFNOL_Ontology graph (Policyholder, Vehicle, Adjuster, RepairShop, Policy, Claim, FraudSignal, SubrogationFlag) with a natural-language question.

question.description: Natural-language question, e.g. 'Show coverage limits for Policy POL-00005'.

200.description: Structured answer grounded in the ontology graph.
